fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM177,970. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0053638/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM) or equivalent with minimum CGPA 2.5; OR Pass 'A' level minimum Grade C in three (3) other subjects. Pass matriculation/Foundation, with minimum CGPA 2.5. Pass any Diploma with minimum CGPA 2.5 (No credit transfer) equivalent MQF Level 4. Pass Diploma in Nursing from a recognized institution by MNB with minimum two (2) years clinical working experience. (Credit transfer allowed) All candidates must possess at least one (1) credit in Science/Biology/Chemistry/Physics/Applied Science at SPM or equivalent, and in Mathematics (Elementary or Additional or Modern) at SPM or equivalent. MUET with minimum of Band 3 / IELTS with a minimum of 5.5 / TOEFL with a minimum score of 515 / 215 / 80. Credit in English (SPM) required.
